# Asif Uddin Ahmed Hemel — Comprehensive Technical Profile & LLM Documentation

> Complete career portfolio, architectural achievements, full tech stack breakdown, and work history for Asif Uddin Ahmed Hemel, Senior Software Engineer & Architect.

## Executive Summary
Asif Uddin Ahmed Hemel is a Senior Software Engineer & Architect with over 5 years of commercial experience designing, building, and deploying mission-critical distributed systems and enterprise web applications. He specializes in full-stack JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystems (React, Angular, Next.js, Node.js, NestJS) and Microsoft .NET ecosystems (.NET 8/7/6, ASP.NET Core, C#, Entity Framework Core), backed by cloud infrastructure on AWS and containerized microservices.

## Professional Experience

### Senior Software Engineer — Enosis Solutions
- Spearheaded the design and modernization of enterprise banking and FinTech web platforms serving 300+ physical branches.
- Architected high-throughput REST APIs and real-time microservices handling thousands of concurrent financial transactions.
- Improved frontend load times by 60% and backend throughput by 200% via database index tuning, query plan optimization, and Redis caching.
- Mentored junior and mid-level engineers in Clean Architecture, design patterns, and automated CI/CD practices.
